name: Kuantum Papers Limited

annual_report.business: Kuantum Papers Limited manufactures high-quality maplitho, copier, creamwove, and specialty papers using a blended furnish of agro and wood pulp at its fully backward-integrated plant in Saila Khurd, Punjab.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Work in Progress (Projects in progress)

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Likely to be completed by 30th September 2026 except Offline Coater Plant which may extend upto 31st March 2027

guidance_or_targets.statement: Upgradation & expansion projects has been commissioned in a phased manner and is likely to be completed in all respect by 30th September 2026 except Offline Coater Plant which may extend upto 31st March 2027.

auditor.name: S. K. SIKKA & ASSOCIATES (Company Secretaries for Corporate Governance Certificate); Statutory Auditor name not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Corporate Governance compliance certified; no qualification on financial statements mentioned in excerpts

key_risks: Surge in low-priced imports leading to oversupplied market and weakened domestic realizations
Rising input costs especially for domestic wood and agro residue due to constrained supply chains and floods in Punjab
Global economic shock from 2026 US-Israel war on Iran triggering surge in oil prices, chemicals and other inputs
Health and safety risks across value chain partners

latest_guidance.statement: Aims to augment Clonal Propagation Center capacity to produce 1 crore clones annually covering 75,000 acres by 2030
Targets freshwater consumption below 30 m³ per tonne of paper in near future
Revenue target of INR1,300 crores plus for FY27
EBITDA margin guidance of about 14% for H2 FY27
Targeting 18-20% EBITDA margins by next financial year FY28
